title.ja: 真剣で私にかかってきなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi ni Kakatte Kinasai!!

1.overview: It's an all out war!  Class 2F goes up against their hated rivals from class 2S.  Little do they know that there's a wild card in the shadows, one that will definitely turn the tide unless they find a way to stop it!
1.summary:
A fierce battle takes place in the mountains of Kanagawa between
students of Kawakami Academy, a school that resolves internal disputes
with martial arts!  Behind the scenes, we see a love story unfold
between a brilliant tactician and the strongest of the Big Four, a
girl with the nickname "the God of Martial Arts." But it seems there
are others after the young tactician`s heart.  Watch to find out just
what class wins the battle and what happens when the other three
members of the Big Four show up...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で任務を完了しなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Ninmu o Kanryou Shinasai!!

2.overview: Someone's stirring up trouble...sexy trouble!  This sounds like something the Kawakami Academy's hidden organization should be involved in.  A secret mission is on the menu, and the Kazuma family is on the case.
2.summary:
I`ve got a secret job from the Kawakami Academy`s hidden organization! Let`s go, Mayuchi!  It`s time for the Kazuma Family to roll out! I`ll bring down the hammer of justice on those who`d peek in on girls changing, or having fun in the bath!  We can`t let them get away with this!  I`ll bring them to justice!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私に萌えなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi ni Moe Nasai!!

3.overview: Miyako will stop at nothing to make Yamato hers.  With Yamato dodging her advances at every turn, this little schoolgirl crush is quickly turning into mission impossible!
3.summary:
Miyako can`t get enough of Yamato and attempts to make him hers, but he`s having none of it.  Why does he keep walking away from Miyako when she obviously cares about him so much? Mayucchi also realizes her feelings towards Yamato and discusses them with Matsukaze...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私と語りなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi to Katari Nasai!!

4.overview: While on the run from Miyako, Yamato finds himself with someone unexpected in the bath.  Using his strategic mind, he must quickly find a way out of this situation, and get going somewhere, anywhere else!
4.summary:
amato gets assaulted by Miyako, as usual, but this time Yamato also runs into someone unexpected in the bath. Yamato engages in fast talking to try to escape safely. Later, he has a heart-to-heart with Doggy.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私に怒りなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi ni Okori Nasai!!

5.overview: Kokoro's rage will not be satisfied until she has Yamato under her boot!  After the humiliation she endured at the hands of the young strategist during the Kawakami Conflict, Kokoro is dead set on getting revenge by any means possible.
5.summary:
amato finds himself the target of Kokoro`s rage after the humiliation she faced during the Kawakami Conflict. Yamato uploaded an embarrassing video to the Internet that`s still the talk of the school. Kokoro vows to take revenge on Yamato only to find out she`s getting involved in a little more than she bargained for.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私とかつぎなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi to Katsugi Nasai!!

6.overview: The annual Kanagawa festival is here, and with it come a set of strange customs and traditions that the Kazama family completely indulge in.  Amid the festivities, Yamato meets a strange man who seems to know his father...
6.summary:
It seems the people of Kanagawa have a rather peculiar festival they celebrate every year and this year everyone in the Kazama family is coming along for the ride. But amidst the festivities, Yamato runs into a stranger that seems to know his father and has a strange aura about him...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私につきあいなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi ni Tsukiai Nasai!!

7.overview: Momoyo tries to talk to Yamato, but she becomes annoyed after seeing him spending time with the other four girls. When Yamato finally gets to see Momoyo, she tries to brush off her jealousy. There have been photographs taken of the girls eating the mushroom-shaped candy during the festival, and they have been distributed worldwide into magazines. Yamato and the girls are tasked to find out who is responsible, but Momoyo chooses to stay behind. Yamato is soon taken hostage by Gyobu Shakadou and the Itagaki Siblings, the group of criminals who were seen in the weapon warehouse from before, as they were the ones responsible for smuggling weapons and magazines overseas. Fortunately, the four girls come to rescue and evade the bomb planted by Gyobu. The two groups begin to fight each other, each faring well against the other. Gyobu attempts to shoot Miyako, but as she dodges it heads toward Yamato, only to be deflected by Momoyo. As Momoyo charges head-on towards Gyobu, she is thwarted by Takae Tachibana, a former member of the "Big Four".
7.summary:
Momoyo is in distress. She has nothing to do, no one to fight. Her life has slowed to a halt. As Momoyo wanders around the city, trouble starts to brew in the shadows as a massive plot unfolds.  Things start to come to light when Yamato runs into the conspirators.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で事情を説明しなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Jijou o Setsumei Shinasai!!

8.overview: Momo's thirst for battle is about to be quenched, with Tachibana Takae stepping up to take her on.  Takae's battle spirit is tremendous, and it may take more than Momo's brtue strength to end this fight.
8.summary:
A big fight ensues, as Tachibana Takae and Kawakami Momoyo really start to go at it. Meanwhile, the plot finally start to unfold and we get a glimpse into what has been going on. But even with the Yamato and the girls helping Momoyo during the fight, Takae doesn`t seem to be going down...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私にカミングアウトしなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi ni Coming Out Shinasai!!

9.overview: Momo is determined to find Tachibana Takae.  Meanwhile, Yamato lies in the hospital with severe injuries.  With all his friends around him, the girls all realize something that will change everything...
9.summary:
Momoyo continues to search for Tachibana Takae while Yamato is severely injured in the hospital. The girls surround him and tell them their feelings for him. It`s a touching scene. But it isn`t too long before the girls realize they`re all rivals for Yamato`s affection...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私とぶつかりなさい!!
title.en: Go at It with Me, Seriously!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi to Butsukari Nasai!!

10.overview: The fight is on!  Momo vs. Takea in a winner take all struggle for supremacy!  As the battle rages, new players get thrown into the fray, but things don't go quite as well as they'd hope they would...
10.summary:
A battle rages over Shinjuku while Momoyo and Takae fight for supremacy. Unfortunately for Momoyo, Saki lurks in the background, giving Momoyo the upper hand. Luckily Yamato jumps in to help even the odds. But things don`t go quite as planned...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私と出撃しなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi to Shutsugeki Shinasai!!

11.overview: At this rate, Yamato will be torn to pieces!  The battle over him is heating up, and none of the girls are willing to back down.  Takea, meanwhile, is busy announcing her own intents to the public.
11.summary:
The heated battle over Yamato continues, with none of the girls willing to back down. Each of them is willing to go further and further, before inevitably it breaks into open warfare. Yamato, meanwhile, considers exactly what he`s fighting for, but it isn`t too long before Tachibana Takae announces her intent to the public...
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 真剣で私に恋しなさい!!
title.x-jat: Maji de Watashi ni Koi Shinasai!!

12.overview: The last battle is at hand, and our heroes are at a disadvantage.  With the odds in the enemy's favor, the group's will, trust, and love will have to see them through the finale of Majikoi: Oh! Samurai Girls!
12.summary:
The final show down comes to a head as everyone gathers on the battlefield in the middle of Tokyo. With the odds stacked against our heroes, they push through using their will and determination to try to save the day, but they`re not alone...
Source: crunchyroll
